body.x: LAS VEGAS, USA (AVING Special Report on 'CES 2008') -- <Visual News> At the 2008, International Consumer Electronics Show (CES), WirelessHD announced the availability of the WirelessHD 1.0 specification, the world’s first consumer-based application of 60GHz for wireless video area networks (WVANs) including the Digital Transmission Content Protection (DTCP) as its content protection method. The WirelessHD specification is available to those companies who become WirelessHD Adopters.

During the press conference at the CES 2008, John Marshall, Chairman of WirelessHD explained that all consumer electronics manufacturers and technology companies involved in creating wireless high definition products and services are invited to become WirelessHD adopters. Currently, the Adopter annual fee is $5k.
For more detail information go to www.wirelesshd.org or email: info@wirelesshd.org
